# opwan_plans (Data Source)

The plans and add-ons on sale. Prices are in cents of `currency`, tax exclusive. Needs no API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_plans" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `add_ons` (Attributes) The add-ons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_ons))
- `currency` (String) `usd`.
- `plans` (Attributes List) The plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--add_ons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `add_ons`

Read-Only:

- `block_sizes` (List of Number) The address block sizes an account may buy at once (1, 2, 4, 8).
- `extra_ip_price_cents` (Number) Per extra address per month.
- `extra_tb_price_cents` (Number) One-time data, per TB, added to the current month.
- `max_extra_ips` (Number) Most extra addresses at checkout; afterwards they are bought in blocks.
- `max_extra_tb` (Number) Most TB one data add-on purchase can buy.
- `max_monthly_tb` (Number) Most monthly data a subscription can have, TB.
- `max_tunnels` (Number) Tunnels per account, each billed at its plan's price.
- `monthly_tb_price_cents` (Number) Monthly data, per TB per month.
- `peak_plan` (String) The plan the peak speed tiers apply to.
- `peak_tiers` (Attributes List) Peak speed tiers, slowest first. The first is the plan's own ceiling at 0 cents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--add_ons--peak_tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--add_ons--peak_tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `add_ons.peak_tiers`

Read-Only:

- `mbps` (Number) Speed ceiling, Mbps.
- `price_cents` (Number) Per month on top of the plan.



<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `allowance_bytes` (Number) Data per calendar month, both directions.
- `ceil_mbps` (Number) Speed ceiling.
- `id` (String) `base` or `plus`.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `price_cents` (Number) Per month.
- `rate_mbps` (Number) Guaranteed rate under contention.
- `slow_mbps` (Number) The ceiling once the month's allowance is used.
